description: Enlargement and relocation of existing vehicular access to the front of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 01/02 A Received 07 September 2023 
02/02 C, 03/02 C Received 27 September 2023

Condition : 3 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the existing vehicular access to the house shall be permanently closed and kerbs/footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.

Condition : 4 - Either side of the vehicle access hereby approved, visibility splay areas (the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, with a splay of at least 2.4 metres x 2.4 metres) shall be provided before the access and parking area is brought into use.  These areas shall be kept clear of any obstructions to visibility greater than 600 mm in height, including shrubs, planting, boundary walls, fences, gates, other means of enclosure or other structures or objects at all times.
Condition : 5 - Prior to first use of the crossover, a 600mm boundary wall shall be constructed on each side of the new access and retained for the lifetime of the development.
